evidence_gaps: Fresh runtime forensics within two hours are unavailable; evidence.json explicitly reports MISSING_RUNTIME_FORENSICS.
No per-strategy, per-chain money-weighted realised NET P&L after every fee, slippage, price-impact, gas/priority/builder cost and refundable-rent adjustment.
No complete attempt ledger correlating signal, quote, simulation, submission, inclusion, wallet-delta reconciliation and final outcome.
No fresh separation of STRATEGY/MARKET losses from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures, including pending and censored attempts.
No out-of-sample performance by strategy, chain, regime, asset, position size and observation window.
No follower-edge decay evidence by signal age, entry deterioration and leader-chain cohort.
No forecast-versus-realised calibration, cost-estimation error distribution, profit factor, drawdown, largest loss or failure-adjusted expectancy.

Before any promotion: require sufficient reconciled closed outcomes, complete cost coverage, positive cumulative money-weighted net and profit factor out of sample, bounded drawdown, stable chain/regime breakdown, acceptable execution-failure rate, and preserved liquidity, sellability, simulation, reserve, signing, reconciliation and circuit-breaker controls.

proposals.downside_risk: Fewer immediately usable observations and longer SHADOW evaluation windows.

evidence.detail: _EXECUTED_STATUSES includes BROADCAST and SUCCESS_FEE_PENDING, while _record_market_native_progress falls back from realised_net_base to expected_net_base and records the result as a LIVE trade.
evaluate_strategy can emit PROMOTION_CANDIDATE from aggregated net profit and profit factor without checking whether every outcome is reconciled and realised.

proposals.expected_effect: Prevents premature strategy promotion and produces trustworthy realised net economics plus a separate execution reliability denominator.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 reconciled closed cycles across at least 3 independent time windows, plus all pending attempts resolved or explicitly censored.
proposals.rationale: A broadcast transaction is not a realised outcome, and an expected result is not money-weighted NET P&L. Mixing these states can create false profit or loss evidence. Market-negative reconciled outcomes should be classified STRATEGY/MARKET; reverted, dropped, unresolved, RPC-failed or reconciliation-incomplete attempts should be classified EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE and excluded from realised P&L until resolved.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay at least 100 historical or synthetic EVM attempts spanning confirmed success, revert, dropped/broadcast-only, fee-pending and reconciliation-missing states. Require realised strategy P&L to include only confirmed reconciled wallet deltas after gas, fees and slippage; require all other attempts to appear only in execution-failure or pending buckets. Stop if any unresolved attempt changes realised net profit or promotion status.

proposals.downside_risk: More missing-cost abstentions and reduced apparent opportunity volume.

evidence.detail: The scorecard stores quote-simulated net and correctly marks it non-promotional, but its common fee_base and slippage_base fields do not expose detailed chain-specific cost attribution.
The portability requirements explicitly call for separate Solana priority/Jito and EVM gas/MEV assumptions.
Solana execution architecture separately models base fee, priority fee, Jito tip, platform fee, price impact, slippage and route hops.
EVM discovery rows initially set estimated_gas_base and builder_fee_base to zero, with wallet-specific simulation deferred.

proposals.expected_effect: Improves abstention and strategy selection based on executable chain-specific NET P&L rather than gross spread or raw signal count.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 executable simulations and 30 reconciled closed outcomes per strategy-chain cohort across at least 3 market regimes; no pooling across chains for promotion evidence.
proposals.rationale: Cross-chain ranking in native units or with generic cost buckets is not economically comparable. Solana edge must reserve priority/Jito/platform and route costs; EVM edge must include gas, builder/MEV exposure and revert cost. Discovery quotes with zero gas must never be interpreted as executable net edge.
proposals.shadow_test: For every SHADOW candidate, snapshot the pre-trade quote and chain-specific cost decomposition, then compare with simulated and subsequently reconciled outcomes. Require positive net under a conservative cost quantile and report calibration separately by chain and regime. Stop a strategy-chain cohort if cost coverage is below 95%, median forecast error is materially biased positive, or cumulative reconciled net after all costs is non-positive.

proposals.downside_risk: Cohort segmentation increases sample requirements and may leave most leaders without enough evidence.

evidence.detail: Leader selection uses historical net, profit speed, positive ratio and copy score; recommendations apply a follower edge haircut and require fresh quote, simulation, liquidity, sellability and conservative positive profit.
Solana applies signal-age, entry-deterioration, copied-performance, fee-share and impact/slippage controls, reflecting material follower timing and execution decay.

Leader-copy recording currently converts closed net outcomes into aggregate wins/losses but does not preserve signal-age, entry deterioration, leader edge, follower edge or failure cause in Strategy Lab metadata.

proposals.expected_effect: Identifies leader-chain-latency cohorts that retain positive follower edge and keeps stale or non-replicable cohorts dormant.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 reconciled follower closed cycles per leader-chain cohort, 5 independent active days, and at least 20 observations in each promoted signal-age bucket.
proposals.rationale: A historically profitable leader can be unprofitable for the follower after latency and chain-specific costs. The strategy should be judged on follower money-weighted net edge conditional on signal age and deterioration, not leader win rate. Negative reconciled follower outcomes with successful execution are STRATEGY/MARKET losses; failed or unresolved execution attempts are EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failures.
proposals.shadow_test: Record leader-side reconstructed edge, follower quote edge, signal age, entry deterioration, complete costs, execution status and reconciled follower net for every eligible signal, including abstentions. Compare fixed out-of-sample cohorts by chain and age bucket. Stop a cohort when at least 20 reconciled copies have non-positive cumulative net, profit factor at or below 1, or when execution-failure incidence prevents reliable attribution.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy because repository thresholds or safety gates appear conservative.
rejected_ideas.reason: Architecture cannot establish realised profitability, calibration or current execution reliability.

rejected_ideas.idea: Increase trade frequency by lowering minimum edge, liquidity, sellability, simulation, fee, slippage or price-impact protections.
rejected_ideas.reason: More trades do not imply positive money-weighted net P&L and would weaken required safety controls.

rejected_ideas.idea: Rank Solana and EVM strategies by raw win count, gross spread or unconverted native-unit profit.
rejected_ideas.reason: These measures ignore position size and materially different chain-specific execution costs.

rejected_ideas.idea: Treat all negative or missing outcomes as strategy losses.
rejected_ideas.reason: Reconciled negative executions are STRATEGY/MARKET evidence, while revert, RPC, dropped, unresolved and reconciliation failures are EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE evidence.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository generally enforces positive executable edge, chain-specific cost controls and SHADOW-first governance, but Strategy Lab can treat BROADCAST, fee-pending or expected EVM results as completed LIVE economic evidence. This can contaminate money-weighted evaluation and obscure STRATEGY/MARKET loss versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure. No profitability, CANARY-readiness or LIVE-readiness conclusion is possible without fresh runtime forensics.
